content.text: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod. My name is Marco.
content.trans: 你好大家，欢迎来到英语有声。我的名字是Marco。

content.text: My name is Catherine and today we've got an upper intermediate level lesson for you all about money.
content.trans: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们要给大家上一堂关于金钱的中级课程。

content.text: That's right. We are trading money. We're actually negotiating in this very popular topic now a days the whole foreign exchange market.
content.trans: 没错。我们正在交易货币。我们现在正在这个非常流行的热门话题上进行谈判，整个外汇市场。

content.text: Okay, so we're talking about currency, which is the money of different countries. For example, the currency of Ecuador is...
content.trans: 好的，我们说的是货币，这是不同国家的货币。例如，厄瓜多尔的货币是...

content.text: ...Best Dollar. Yeah, yeah, hard to believe but true. I'll tell you all about it later.
content.trans: 当然啦，这个美元真好。嗯，嗯，真的很难相信但是是真的。我以后再告诉你吧。

content.text: Okay, well the currency of America is also the US dollar so with that in mind let's listen to today's dialogue.
content.trans: 好的，美国的货币也是美元。所以，让我们听听今天的对话吧。

content.text: Hey John, I haven't seen you in ages. What's new? What have you been up to? Pete, nice to see you.
content.trans: 嘿约翰，好久不见了。最近怎么样？你都做了些什么？彼得，见到你真是太高兴了。

content.text: Well, on top of the norm, you know, life and kids and work, I've actually gotten into doing some trading.
content.trans: 嗯，除了常规的生活、孩子和工作之外，我还真的开始做一些交易了。

content.text: Trading? You be gay? What are you trading? Currencies. Currencies. As in Euros, Dollars, Pounds and Rupees?
content.trans: 交易？你就是gay吗？你在换什么？货币。比如欧元、美元、英镑和卢比。

content.text: It's called Forex, foreign exchange. The great thing about it is that I don't have to invest a huge amount.
content.trans: 它叫外汇，外汇。它的优点之一就是我不需要投入大量的资金。

content.text: I put in a margin deposit and then I can buy and sell up to 100 times that much.
content.trans: 我打了一笔保证金，然后就可以买和卖最多一百倍那么多。

content.text: I don't understand. You're buying and selling money? You got it. Just last night I made 150 US Dollars.
content.trans: 我不明白。你是在买卖钱吗？没错，昨天晚上我赚了150美元。

content.text: Last night? Yeah, it's a 24 hour market. I bought some Rem and Bee earlier at a low asking price but last night I'd appreciated drastically.
content.trans: 昨晚呢？是24小时市场。昨天我买了些Rem和Bee，价格还很低，但昨晚我就特别开心了。

content.text: So I made a split second decision and sold all of my RMB at an amazing bid.
content.trans: 我瞬间做出了决定，把所有的人民币都以天价卖掉了。

content.text: I've also done some trading with Swiss francs and Australian Dollars and Hong Kong Dollars.
content.trans: 我也和瑞士法郎、澳大利亚元和港币进行了些交易。

content.text: I've made some good profits but I've also suffered some losses. Depends on a lot of factors just like any other market.
content.trans: 我有些不错的收益，但也有一些损失。就像任何其他市场一样，取决于很多因素。

content.text: In total, I've made about 500 US Dollars in the past few months. You're kidding! I'm on! Where do I sign up?
content.trans: 最近几个月，我已经赚了大约五千美元。你开玩笑的吧！我报名好了！签不签约？

content.text: We're back so this guy is trading currencies as we heard. We're going to talk about a lot of the specific vocab that he used about this topic.
content.trans: 我们又回来了，这个家伙正在用我们听说的特定词汇谈论这一话题。

content.text: Why don't we take a look at some of those now in language takeaway?
content.trans: 为什么不来看看我们这些现在在语言外卖里的呢？

content.text: Language takeaway.
content.trans:
语言小贴士。
中文：关于语言学习的提示。

content.text: The first thing I think we should talk about is one of the first things he says actually. Peter says, I haven't seen you in ages.
content.trans: 首先，我们应该谈论的是他第一次说的一个。彼得说：“我好长时间没见到你了。”

content.text: I haven't seen you in ages. Right. So obviously he hasn't seen him in a long time and that's what in ages means.
content.trans: 好长时间没见你了。对，所以显然他也没多久见过面，那“好久不见”就是这个意思。

content.text: That's right. So we haven't seen each other in ages.
content.trans: 没错。所以好多年没见了。

content.text: So what other ways can we use in ages or the word ages?
content.trans: 当然，除了“年龄”这个词之外，在中文里还有哪些方式可以用来表达“岁月”的呢？

content.text: Well you could actually say it's been ages. So that means it's been a long time.
content.trans: 你可以说已经很久了。这意味着时间很长。

content.text: It's been a long time or we haven't gone out for ages.
content.trans: 好长时间没出去了。

content.text: Okay, so then you can use it with four ages.
content.trans: 好的，那就可以用在四岁小朋友身上。

content.text: Four ages in ages. So the key word here is ages which means a long time.
content.trans: 四个时代，时光荏苒。关键词就是“岁月”，意味着很长的时间。

content.text: Long time. Okay. Well he hasn't seen him in ages and the guy is like well you know what? I've actually gone into trading.
content.trans: 好久不见。好的，他很久没见到这个人了，这人说你知道吗？我其实已经进去了。

content.text: So that means he started doing some trading.
content.trans: 这意味着他开始做点交易。

content.text: Right. Now trading is a very broad word because you can trade as in this case currencies which is basically to buy and sell currencies.
content.trans: 好的。现在交易是一个非常宽泛的词汇，因为你可以用它来指代像在这种情况下进行货币交易，这主要是为了买入和卖出货币。

content.text: But you could also trade stocks right? Mm-hmm. You can trade stocks or even people that are involved in import export.
content.trans: 但你也可以直接买卖股票吗？嗯，你可以买卖股票，甚至包括进口出口相关的人员。

content.text: They are involved in trading trading. So basically trading is buying and selling something.
content.trans: 他们参与的是交易。所以基本上，交易就是买和卖东西。

content.text: Right. So you're trading. You are exchanging a product for money or money for a product.
content.trans: 好的。所以你是交易。你用产品换钱，或者用钱换产品。

content.text: But the difference is you're not actually making any products. Right. Okay. So that's that's called trading.
content.trans: 但区别就在于你其实并没有真正生产任何产品。对了。那这就是叫作交易。

content.text: You're not really manufacturing anything. You're just exchanging goods and services and money.
content.trans: 你其实就是在交换商品、服务和钱。

content.text: All right. So that's for trading. Now moving on he was explaining how the foreign exchange mark works.
content.trans: 好的。所以这就是关于交易的部分。然后他开始解释外汇标尺是如何工作的。

content.text: And he says I don't have to invest a huge amount. I put in a margin deposit and then I can buy and sell up to a hundred times that much.
content.trans: 他这么说，我不需要投入太多。我只付了一笔保证金，然后就可以买和卖一百倍那么多。

content.text: So Marco here's the question what is a margin deposit?
content.trans: Marco，这是个关于保证金的问题。

content.text: Because a deposit is basically money that you put invest somewhere or that you you pay in.
content.trans: 因为押金基本上是你把钱存到某个地方，或者你付进去的钱。

content.text: Right. Well basically a margin deposit is like a percentage. So he basically puts in a percentage of what he intends to buy.
content.trans: 好的。基本上，这是保证金，就像买的时候付了一部分钱。所以他付的金额是打算买的金额的一部分。

content.text: So for example a margin deposit of a thousand dollars might be one dollar for ten dollars.
content.trans: 比如，一万元的保证金可能只需要一千元。

content.text: Okay. So maybe if it's ten dollars you're talking about a one percent margin.
content.trans: 好的。所以如果你说的是十美元，那可能就是一成的利润吧。

content.text: Exactly. So that's what he means by a margin deposit. And that's why he explains that you don't have to have a large amount of money in order to trade in the foreign exchange market.
content.trans: 是的。所以，他指的是一个保证金。而且，他解释说，你不需要有大量的外汇储备才能在外汇市场进行交易。

content.text: You just put in a margin deposit and then you can work around that.
content.trans: 你只要交了定金，就可以绕过这个。

content.text: Well it sounds pretty easy but then he explains some more details about it and it gets to be a little bit more complicated.
content.trans: 确实听起来挺简单的，但后来他又解释了一些细节，这就有点儿复杂了。

content.text: That's right he explained about how he makes money and how he bought some Chinese remin B. And then he sold it because it appreciated drastically.
content.trans: 没错，他解释了他是如何赚钱的以及他买了些中国红木。然后他又把它卖了，因为价格大幅上涨了。

content.text: So he bought it when it was cheap and he sold it when it was expensive. So the price changed.
content.trans: 所以，他以便宜的价格买了它，然后以昂贵的价格卖了。结果价格变了。

content.text: Right.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: So this kind of price change when something goes from cheap to expensive it's called appreciating.
content.trans: 这种东西从便宜变贵的时候的价格变化，就叫做增值。

content.text: Appreciating. So the verb is to appreciate.
content.trans: 理解了。这个动词是“欣赏”。

content.text: It's very different from using it in the sense of you appreciate someone.
content.trans: 确实和你把它们当成礼物是完全不同的感觉。

content.text: Like I really appreciate you.
content.trans: 确实非常感谢你。

content.text: Yeah no it's very different. We could say this about most goods or investments.
content.trans: 好的，这和大多数商品或投资的情况不一样。

content.text: For example my parents bought a house in 1970 and the value of the house has really appreciated over the last 40 years.
content.trans: 比如我父母在1970年买的房子，这房子的价值在这40年间真的升值了。

content.text: So now the value is much much greater.
content.trans: 现在这个价值简直翻了好几倍。

content.text: And actually just mentioning it while we're on the topic to appreciate as you say is something becomes more expensive.
content.trans: 确实是在我们讨论这个话题的时候顺便提到的，就像你所说的那样，是一种成本会增加的行为。

content.text: The opposite when something becomes cheaper or maybe the value goes down is to depreciate.
content.trans: 当某物变得便宜，或者价值下降时，就是贬值。

content.text: De-preciate so that the beginning means it's going down.
content.trans: 贬值处理，意味着开始的时候就是往下走。

content.text: Right. Okay. And moving on to our last word for language takeaway.
content.trans: 好的。好了，我们最后说的语言取走词是什么呢？

content.text: So when he was talking about selling the Chinese currency he said that he sold it at an amazing bid.
content.trans: 所以当他谈论出售人民币时，他说他以一个惊人的出价卖掉了它。

content.text: Okay let's talk about bid here. B-I-D bid. What does this mean?
content.trans: 好的，我们来聊聊这个“BID”吧。B-I-D，是什么意思？

content.text: So to bid is to place an offer for something.
content.trans: 所以，投标就是对某物提出报价。

content.text: Okay so for example at an auction when someone is selling many old objects or some art.
content.trans: 好的，比如在拍卖会上，当有人出售许多旧物品或艺术品时。

content.text: I can bid $100.
content.trans: 我可以用100块。

content.text: Right.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: And maybe someone doesn't accept my bid.
content.trans: 而且，也许有人不接受我的报价。

content.text: Mm-hmm.
content.trans: 嗯，好的。

content.text: But if they do accept my bid then I pay for it.
content.trans: 但如果你接受了我的报价，那我就付钱。

content.text: Right. So basically a bid is just another way of saying an offer.
content.trans: 好的。所以简而言之，投标就是另一种说法是报价。

content.text: You're offering a certain amount of money for that product or that service.
content.trans: 你为那个产品或服务报价了多少钱。

content.text: And you see it a lot for example on eBay, right?
content.trans: 你看，比如在eBay上你经常会看到。

content.text: That's right. So eBay is an auction website basically.
content.trans: 没错。所以eBay基本上就是一个拍卖网站。

content.text: And someone who's selling someone can see many many bids and they select the best bid.
content.trans: 而且，正在出售的人可以看到很多很多的竞标，并且会选择最好的竞标。

content.text: Exactly so that's what a bid is.
content.trans: 就是说，这就是投标。

content.text: So that's all we have for language takeaway.
content.trans: 是的，这就是我们所有关于语言交流的内容。

content.text: Let's move on now to Fluency Builder.
content.trans: 好的，我们接下来就进入流畅训练器。

content.text: So Marco, you have to explain this to me.
content.trans: 所以，Marco，你得给我解释一下。

content.text: We're talking about currency today.
content.trans: 今天咱们聊聊货币。

content.text: Every nation has a currency.
content.trans: 每个国家都有自己的货币。

content.text: For example, in the dialogue, we learned that India has rupees, pounds are in Britain.
content.trans: 例如，在对话中，我们了解到印度有卢比，英镑在英国。

content.text: Britain has pounds and Australia has Australian Dollars.
content.trans: 英国有英镑，澳大利亚有澳元。

content.text: America has American Dollars, but you just said earlier that Ecuador has American Dollars too.
content.trans: 美国有美元，但你刚才说厄瓜多尔也有美元。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: Actually, Ecuador went through a very difficult economic situation in late 1998, early 1999,
content.trans: 实际上，厄瓜多尔在20世纪90年代末期和20世纪初遇到了非常艰难的经济状况。

content.text: where there was hyperinflation.
content.trans: 哪里曾经发生过通货膨胀。

content.text: So basically, there was an inflation that was very, very, very large.
content.trans: 所以基本上，通胀率非常高。

content.text: So that means that the old currency lost its value very fast?
content.trans: 所以这意味着旧币的价值很快就贬值了？

content.text: Exactly.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: So for example, if the currency before an Ecuador used to be sucres,
content.trans: 例如，如果厄瓜多尔之前使用的是苏菜币，现在应该改用美元。

content.text: so if 10 sucres was $1, all of a sudden it was $50.
content.trans: 所以，如果糖是十块一美元，突然之间就变成了五十个。

content.text: Oh wow.
content.trans: 哇哦。

content.text: And it got to the point where goods and services went from $3,000 to $25,000 to $1.
content.trans: 而且到最后，商品和服务的价格从三千美元变成了两千五百美元，然后又变成了一千美元。

content.text: Okay, so people have bags full of money and it's not really worth anything anymore.
content.trans: 好的，人们口袋里装着一大笔钱，其实已经不值钱了。

content.text: Exactly.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: So what happened was the central bank couldn't absorb this currency depreciation.
content.trans: 所以，事情就是中央银行无法吸收这种货币贬值。

content.text: We couldn't really regulate prices.
content.trans: 我们真的很难控制价格。

content.text: Obviously salaries were about the same, so you have a lot less money comparatively.
content.trans: 显然，工资差不多，所以你的钱少多了。

content.text: And so the government decided that there were two options.
content.trans: 所以政府决定有两条路可走。

content.text: Either they would follow Argentina's example, what they did a couple of years before, and set a fixed rate.
content.trans: 要么他们照搬阿根廷的做法，几年前就已经做过的那种固定费率。

content.text: So our Nargentina, it's three pesos to a dollar.
content.trans: 所以我们的阿根廷，是三比索兑换一美元。

content.text: Or we would just get rid of our currency and just use US Dollars.
content.trans: 我们干脆就废了我们的货币，直接用美元就行了。

content.text: So that's what they did, right?
content.trans: 对，那就是他们做的。

content.text: They used US Dollars and now if you ever travel to Ecuador, you will use US Dollars.
content.trans: 他们用美元，现在如果你去厄瓜多尔旅行，你就会使用美元。

content.text: The same exact bills that you use in the US are the same exact bills in Ecuador.
content.trans: 同样的在美国使用的钞票，在厄瓜多尔也是相同的。

content.text: So no need to exchange currency.
content.trans: 所以不用兑换货币。

content.text: No need to exchange currency.
content.trans: 不需要换货币。

content.text: And that's why I guess there are many factors that people say are a lot better.
content.trans: 那就是为什么我觉得人们说的很多因素其实都挺好的。

content.text: For example, trading has become a lot less complicated because now you're negotiating in US Dollars
content.trans: 比如，交易现在变得很简单了，因为你可以在美元上进行谈判了

content.text: as everywhere else in the world.
content.trans: 在世界其他地方也是如此。

content.text: But then other things as you know not having a national currency also affect.
content.trans: 但你知道的，除了没有国家货币之外，还有其他事情也受到影响。

content.text: So there are a lot of things going on, but it's an interesting topic.
content.trans: 确实有很多事情在发生，但这是一个有趣的话题。

content.text: Very interesting.
content.trans: 非常有趣。

content.trans: 好吧，剪个头发多少钱？

content.trans: 没错，因为这些都是每个人都需要的东西，所以价格变化不大。
